name: sit_knees_up
text: A person sits on the ground hugging both knees toward the chest. Both knees are raised, feet rest on the floor in front, torso curls slightly forward. Wrap both forearms around the shins below the knees and hold this compact seated pose throughout. Remain seated, no standing up.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 坐地屈膝，双臂绕在膝部两侧，手放在小腿前侧，未做双手相扣。左右分手约束消除叠手，保持循环最低关节点为+0.8厘米。
